summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Nikki Tech Labs Contact Scraper platform. Backend: 34/35 tests passed (97.1%). Frontend: All core flows working after backend restart. Google Maps, YouTube, and Website scrapers tested with REAL data. Instagram/Facebook/Google Search correctly return 400 (API keys not configured as expected). Razorpay correctly returns 400 (not configured). Super admin panel fully functional.

flaky_endpoints.issue: Intermittent 500 errors due to HTTP/2 connection pool issues with Supabase
flaky_endpoints.symptoms: After prolonged use, some requests to Supabase fail with httpcore HTTP/2 connection errors
flaky_endpoints.workaround: Backend restart clears the issue. Likely a connection pool exhaustion or stale connection issue.

integration_issues.issue: When backend has HTTP/2 connection issues, frontend shows error overlay that blocks all interactions
integration_issues.note: This is a symptom of the backend HTTP/2 issue, not a frontend bug per se

action_item_for_main_agent: MEDIUM PRIORITY: Investigate HTTP/2 connection pool issue with Supabase. After prolonged backend use (multiple test runs), httpcore raises HTTP/2 connection errors causing 500 responses. This blocks frontend with error overlay. Workaround: backend restart clears it. Possible fixes: (1) Add connection pool timeout/max lifetime settings to httpx client in db.py, (2) Implement connection pool recycling, (3) Add retry logic for transient Supabase connection errors. Not blocking for MVP but should be addressed before production load testing.
